manc_broker.text: Welcome to the Royal Exchange. Shares, dividends and a commission for my trouble. Fancy a flutter?

manc_trader.text: Buy cheap, sell dear. That's the whole secret. The hard bit is knowing which is which.
Brolly & Sons goes up when it rains. In Manchester. So, mostly up.

manc_pundit.text: Keep an eye on Vane Industries. Everyone says it can only go up. That's usually when I get nervous.
Commission on every deal, mind. Trade too often and the only one getting rich is the broker.

manc_auctioneer.text: Auctions for the Enclosure's old leases. Gavel, catalogue, tea urn. The tea urn is not for sale. Shall we?
